settings.text: Everything you need to know about our platform, plans, and support.

settings.question: How do I get started?
settings.answer: Simply sign up for a free account, complete the onboarding wizard, and you'll be up and running within minutes. No credit card required.

settings.question: Can I import existing data?
settings.answer: Yes! We support CSV and Excel imports for student records, staff data, and fee structures. Our team can also help with bulk migrations.

settings.question: Is there a mobile app?
settings.answer: Our platform is fully responsive and works perfectly on any device. Dedicated mobile apps for iOS and Android are also available.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: We accept all major credit and debit cards, UPI, net banking, and bank transfers. Custom invoicing is also available for enterprise clients.

settings.question: Can multiple staff members use the platform?
settings.answer: Absolutely! You can create unlimited staff accounts with role-based permissions so everyone gets access to exactly what they need.

settings.question: Do you provide training?
settings.answer: We offer free onboarding training, video tutorials, and a comprehensive knowledge base. Premium plans include dedicated training sessions.
